Nor'vak stood in his lair, clutching the head of the lifeless Lot'dy scum before him. He too was a Lot'dy, but one of pure breeding and massive stature. And unlike the others in his family, he wasn't Naga-worshiping grovelling filth. He was, in his madness, above that. He was truly a demi-god in his own mind. Of course he had no real power and what little he had came from his quick reflexes and convenient location.

Nor'vak was born in Labyrinths Edge, which itself had no real value except for the strong breeding of the Lot'dy and Naga that came from it. The Lot'dy from here were sold to the highest nobility of the Naga for exceptional prices, and there were very few Slaves born among them. It was situated at the edge of cliff edge made of porous stone, carved by years of water flow into a vast and unchartable series of caves. This attracted some of the most dangerous populations of predators and creatures to them, all fighting of the scraps of creatures that made the mistake of wandering in.

He too, would have been sold when he came of age. The highest bidder was Saoirse, a Naga princess, and he would soon have been able to fight and die along with her. But his twin brother, destined to be sold to some lowly merchant as a body guard, and his damned inferiority complex got in the way. His twin attacked him at night in his sleep, wounding Nor'vak gravely and cutting off his arm, leaving him to die in his quarters. His blasted brother took his place, stealing from him the honor and glory.

Nor'vak cursed his brother again, but fortunately his actions caused Nor'vak to become the creature he was actually meant to be. His masters upon finding him wounded, his sword arm cold and stiff beside him simply decided to dispose of him. As long as the Naga princess was fooled, they would get their money, and what would a one-armed guard be worth anyway. He was dumped along with all the other rotting corpses in the Labyrinth, as feast to the creatures that lived there. As the creatures nibbled at his body, his resolve began to stiffen. He would not die for this.

He recovered slowly in the Labyrinth, eating the corpses and carcasses dumped there along with scavengers and beasts. And he went mad. Whether it be the winding caves and the darkness, the creatures whose snarls and growls constantly haunted the air, or just the scent of rot of evil, in the Labyrinth he slowly lost his mind.

The Naga Lord of Labyrinths Edge took interest with him after finding out that such a creature prowled in the Labyrinth. He had him captured (to the demise of about a dozen slave catchers) and brought him before himself. He had a sword made to replace the arm Nor'vak had lost. He then put up a bid for creature, advertising him as "Nor'vak the Mad". Little did the Naga Lord know, the Lot'dy thought himself to be a demi-god. And no god serves the Naga.

Nor'vak escaped to the Labyrinth, hacking down any guard or catcher that tried to stop him. He lived up to his namesake. Knowing that once he was in the Labyrinth, in his own home which Nor'vak had carefully memorized, there was absolutely no feasible way to catch him, the Naga Lord simply forgot his effort. Instead he used Nor'vak as a sort of garbage disposal, since he clearly enjoyed killing and devouring any Lot'dy he sent in.

But his latest prey was certainly the most useful. It was a courier sentenced to death for reading the confidential messages between the Naga. It took him a while to catch him, the courier was unreasonably fast. The courier begged and grovelled to be spared, saying he had so much information he could tell him.

"What use does Nor'vak the Mad have for information?" he slithered as approached his cornered prey.

"Nor'vak, Nor'vak! I lived here, I was your age, remember me?!?"

"Your flesh will bring Nor'vak sweet memories."

"Y-you.. I know what happened to you! It's a tragedy! Your brother!"

"What of him?!" He snarled, grabbing the couriers head and starting to crush it with his hand.

"The Princess Saoirse, I delivered a message to her!"

Nor'vak stopped.

"Sa'vak! That was his name! Sa'vak!"

"Do not say this name."

"Please, Nor'vak, spare me. I will tell you the message I delivered to her."

"I will spare you..."

"It came from Dire Vents. It was a bounty on the head of some disobedient gladiator. A worthless Slave. But he lead a revolt and the Lord of the Keep put a bounty on him. Mar'dy Kist. Thats where shes going. To Dire Vents."

Nor'vak pondered for a moment. This was a chance. A chance to exact his revenge on his filth brother.

"Please..please" the courier pleaded.

"I will spare you the painful death I had planned for you." Nor'vak said calmly.

"Oh than-" [And he slit the couriers throat](https://sli.mg/inQOxo).

First you have to find a brokerage account that will take it, like ETrade\Scottrade and setup an account so you have the # to transfer it to. If its an old one not managed by your employer then it should be easy, just tell them to roll it over to the new account. If it is managed by your employer, then you have to read the fine print in your plan, and take that to your HR or 401k people at work and tell them you want to roll it over. I had to argue with them for weeks about it, finally showing them the fine print that says it is allowable worked.
